caption: The drawing depicts a stylized rooster positioned centrally on a light, off-white background. The rooster’s body is filled with dense, wavy, and overlapping lines in shades of red and muted brown, creating a feathered texture. The bird’s tail curves upward and to the right, matching the reddish-brown pattern and is outlined with a bold red line. The head features a grayish section with a red comb on top and a small red wattle below the beak. There are two visible eyes represented by small, round dots. The legs of the rooster are depicted as two parallel, elongated U-shaped lines in dark brown that meet at the bottom in a single curved form. Below the right leg, the name "carl strehlau" is written in small greenish letters. The image is composed in a minimalistic, flat style with no other objects or background details present.
title: Weather Vane Rooster
